verdict.rationale: SumUp's terminal payments (Solo/Go readers, Tap to Pay) and hosted/embedded checkout options mean card data is handled by certified devices/vendor infrastructure rather than the developer's own systems, which inherently reduces PCI scope [sumup-docs-5][sumup-docs-9][sumup-docs-20][sumup-docs-29]. However, there is no explicit vendor documentation cited that discusses PCI DSS compliance, SAQ eligibility, or clearly enumerates the developer's remaining compliance obligations. Missing for 10: explicit PCI-DSS/SAQ guidance pages, statements about scope reduction, and any certification/attestation documentation referenced in the evidence pack.
